headline: Mercado Libre Surpasses $10 Billion in Q3 Revenue as Credit Portfolio Grows
summary: Mercado Libre reported third-quarter revenue exceeding $10 billion, driven by a 33% year-over-year increase in platform sales and a credit portfolio reaching $17.9 billion for Mercado Pago. Despite the revenue growth, the company's shares fell over 6%.
why: Mercado Libre is Latin America's largest e-commerce and fintech ecosystem, and its quarterly earnings serve as a key bellwether for consumer demand and digital adoption in the region.

impacts.name: MercadoLibre
impacts.why: The company reported its third-quarter financial results with revenue exceeding $10 billion, while its stock fell over 6%.
